# Loops

> Loops is an email platform for software companies. Send transactional and marketing email from one API, one contact model, and a no-code visual editor, with a free tier that doesn't expire. Built for engineers and lifecycle teams who want both developer-grade APIs and marketer-friendly tools in one place.

## Product
- [Loops home](https://loops.so): What Loops is, who it's for, and how transactional + marketing email work from one platform.
- [Pricing](https://loops.so/pricing): Contact-based pricing with a free plan (1,000 contacts, 4,000 sends/month). No per-email or per-seat charges on paid plans.
- [Transactional email](https://loops.so/email-api): Triggered one-to-one email like password resets, receipts, and login codes, sent from your code.
- [Customers](https://loops.so/customers): Software companies using Loops, with stories and outcomes.

## Developers & API
- [Email API](https://loops.so/email-api): The email API for software companies — REST endpoint, typed SDKs, webhooks, and lifecycle workflows. Free tier to start.
- [Email API buyer guide](https://loops.so/email-api): How SaaS teams should evaluate developer email APIs across transactional email, lifecycle workflows, templates, SDKs, webhooks, deliverability, data model, and pricing.
- [API reference](https://loops.so/docs/api-reference/intro): Endpoints, authentication, and rate limits (10 req/s per team). Base URL https://app.loops.so/api.
- [Send a transactional email](https://loops.so/docs/api-reference/send-transactional-email): POST /v1/transactional with transactionalId, email, and dataVariables.
- [JavaScript / TypeScript SDK](https://loops.so/docs/sdks/javascript): `npm install loops` — LoopsClient and sendTransactionalEmail.
- [Python SDK](https://github.com/loops-so/loops-python): `pip install loops-so` — sync and async clients.
- [Go SDK](https://github.com/loops-so/loops-go): `go get github.com/loops-so/loops-go`.
- [Quickstart](https://loops.so/docs/quickstart): Create a contact, send an event, and send your first email.

## AI agents
- [Loops for agents](https://loops.so/agents): How AI agents and coding tools build, edit, and send email with Loops.
- [Agent setup](https://loops.so/agents/setup): Connect an agent or coding assistant to a Loops workspace.
- [Migrate with an agent](https://loops.so/agents/migrate): Move existing email/templates into Loops programmatically.
- [Loops CLI](https://loops.so/agents/cli): Terminal access to contacts, lists, events, transactional, campaigns, and email messages.
- [Loops MCP](https://loops.so/agents/mcp): Model Context Protocol server for agent access to Loops.
- [Agent API](https://loops.so/agents/api): API surface for agent-driven email workflows.
- [LMX](https://loops.so/agents/lmx): Loops Markup Language — the format for composing email content for the editor and Content API.
- [Skills](https://loops.so/agents/skills): Reusable agent skills for Loops workflows.
- [Workflows](https://loops.so/agents/workflows): Multi-step automations triggered by events.

## Resources & guides
- [Email deliverability best practices](https://loops.so/resources/email-deliverability): Authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), sender reputation, list hygiene, warming, and a copy-ready checklist for software senders.
- [Why are my emails going to spam?](https://loops.so/resources/why-emails-go-to-spam): The seven causes of spam placement, each with a fix, plus a 5-minute diagnostic and the 2024+ Gmail/Yahoo sender rules.
- [Best time to send email](https://loops.so/resources/best-time-to-send-email): What public data says about send timing by day and audience, and how to find your own.
- [Glossary](https://loops.so/glossary): Plain-language definitions of email and lifecycle-marketing terms.
- [Cold email](https://loops.so/glossary/cold-email): What cold email is, how it differs from opt-in marketing and transactional email, and why outreach should stay separate from product sending.
- [CAN-SPAM](https://loops.so/glossary/can-spam): Plain-language overview of U.S. commercial email requirements, opt-out handling, and transactional-vs-commercial email distinctions.
- [Reply-to email address](https://loops.so/glossary/reply-to-email-address): What reply-to means, how it differs from From, and how SaaS teams route replies for support, billing, sales, and product email.
- [Preview text](https://loops.so/glossary/preview-text-or-pre-header-text): What preview/preheader text is, how long it should be, examples by email type, and formulas for better inbox snippets.
- [Transactional emails](https://loops.so/glossary/transactional-emails): Automated one-to-one product email triggered by user actions, account state, or billing/security events.
- [Hard bounce](https://loops.so/glossary/hard-bounce): Permanent delivery failure caused by invalid addresses, dead domains, deleted mailboxes, or other non-recoverable recipient problems.
- [Soft bounce](https://loops.so/glossary/soft-bounce): Temporary delivery failure caused by full mailboxes, throttling, message-size issues, or recipient-server delays.
- [IP warming](https://loops.so/glossary/ip-warming): Gradual sending-volume ramp for new or changed email infrastructure, plus domain-reputation and engaged-recipient guidance.
- [Improving inbox placement (docs)](https://loops.so/docs/deliverability/improving-inbox-placement): The deliverability playbook — consent, cadence, and content.
- [Sending domain setup (docs)](https://loops.so/docs/sending-domain): Generate and verify SPF, DKIM, and MX records for your domain.

## Examples & templates
- [Email examples](https://loops.so/examples): Real-world onboarding, welcome, and lifecycle email examples with anatomy and best practices.
- [Welcome email examples](https://loops.so/examples/welcome-email-examples): Welcome email anatomy, subject lines, templates, and examples for SaaS signup flows.
- [Onboarding email examples](https://loops.so/examples/onboarding-email-examples): SaaS onboarding email examples, sequence timing, activation templates, and FAQ guidance.
- [Account verification email examples](https://loops.so/examples/account-verification-email-examples): Verification email patterns for signup, magic links, team invites, email changes, and security-sensitive actions.
- [Payment confirmation email examples](https://loops.so/examples/payment-confirmation-email-examples): Receipt, subscription renewal, upgrade, trial conversion, add-on, and refund email templates for SaaS billing flows.
- [Templates](https://loops.so/templates): Starting-point email templates by category.
- [Email template builder guide](https://loops.so/templates/category/all): How SaaS teams should choose template workflows, personalization variables, fallback values, preview text, and examples for marketing, lifecycle, and transactional email.
